decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to utilize aggressive creatures like Savannah Lions, Werebear, Nimble Mongoose, and Terravore to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck also focuses on land destruction with cards like Armageddon and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Weathered Wayfarer helps to find specific lands like Dust Bowl or Kor Haven to control the board further. The deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent while controlling the game through efficient mana use and strategic land destruction.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly apply pressure to the opponent with aggressive creatures like Nantuko Shade and Hypnotic Specter, while disrupting their game plan with cards like Duress and Gerrard's Verdict. The deck also aims to maintain card advantage through Phyrexian Arena and control the board with removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Vindicate. The deck has a strong mana base with a mix of lands like City of Brass and Wasteland to ensure consistency in casting its spells and disrupting the opponent's resources.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize various cards and abilities to create a powerful combo that leads to victory. This is achieved through the use of cards like Intuition, Cabal Therapy, and Stifle to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while utilizing Survival of the Fittest to find key creatures like Phyrexian Dreadnought and Phyrexian Devourer. The deck also includes cards like Lim-Dûl's Vault and Unearth for additional card selection and graveyard recursion. By assembling the right combination of creatures, spells, and abilities, the deck aims to create an overwhelming advantage and secure a win.

The deck revolves around controlling the game through a combination of global enchantments and disruptive spells, while utilizing Oath of Druids to quickly search for powerful creatures like Akroma, Angel of Wrath and Phantom Nishoba. The deck also focuses on card advantage with cards like Sylvan Library and Scroll Rack, as well as various utility cards to deal with threats or disrupt the opponent's strategy. The mana base is designed to maximize consistency and provide access to multiple colors for spells like Swords to Plowshares and Enlightened Tutor.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through various means such as countering opponent's spells, removing threats, and generating card advantage. Cards like Ivory Mask and Story Circle provide protection against specific strategies, while cards like Seal of Cleansing and Swords to Plowshares handle opponent's threats. The deck also includes powerful win conditions such as Replenish and Decree of Justice, as well as a solid mana base to ensure consistency. Overall, the deck aims to outlast opponents and secure victory through efficient control and resource management.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly fill up your graveyard with cards that can be used for madness or threshold synergies, while also utilizing aggressive creatures to chip away at your opponent's life total. By strategically using cards like Circular Logic and Roar of the Wurm, you can control the board and overwhelm your opponent with efficient threats. The deck aims to be proactive and apply pressure early on, using cards like Wild Mongrel and Basking Rootwalla to create a fast and furious gameplay style.

The main idea of this deck is to control the pace of the game by using counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage to disrupt the opponent's strategy. This UR Control deck aims to maintain board control through cards like Nevinyrral's Disk and Parallax Tide while using versatile spells like Fact or Fiction and Cunning Wish to adapt to different situations. The deck also includes efficient creature removal like Lightning Bolt and Fire / Ice, along with a few win conditions such as Shard Phoenix and Faerie Conclave. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the deck's color requirements.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal, and card advantage. The goal is to keep the opponent's threats in check with cards like Swords to Plowshares and Wrath of God, while drawing cards and generating value with Fact or Fiction and Standstill. The deck is supplemented with utility lands like Wasteland and Dust Bowl to disrupt the opponent's mana base. By effectively managing resources and maintaining board control, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and eventually win through efficient threats like Mishra's Factory and Decree of Justice.

This deck focuses on setting up a combo using cards like Phyrexian Devourer and Triskelion to deal lethal damage to the opponent. It utilizes cards like Mesmeric Fiend and Cabal Therapy to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while also using cards like Intuition and Survival of the Fittest to find key combo pieces. The deck also benefits from mana acceleration provided by cards like Birds of Paradise and Llanowar Elves. By carefully navigating the graveyard and using efficient removal, this deck aims to quickly assemble its combo and win the game.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying efficient creatures to apply pressure on the opponent while also utilizing cards like Call of the Herd and Survival of the Fittest to generate additional threats. By utilizing a combination of mana acceleration from cards like Llanowar Elves and Gaea's Cradle, as well as powerful creatures like Blastoderm and Flametongue Kavu, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive game plan. The inclusion of cards like Anger and Masticore provide additional removal and reach to close out games.

The main idea of this deck is to slow down and control the game by using counterspells, removal spells, and land destruction while keeping the opponent's threats at bay. It includes cards like Masticore for board control, Nevinyrral's Disk for mass removal, and various counterspells like Mana Leak and Counterspell to disrupt the opponent's plans. Standstill can also be used to force the opponent to decide between drawing cards or playing spells. Overall, the deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent until victory is achieved.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble and protect the combo of Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle, resulting in a powerful win condition. The deck includes various cheap counterspells and disruptive spells to control the game until the combo can be put together. The strategy revolves around using disruption and card advantage to stall opponents while efficiently setting up the combo. The deck aims to create a strong board presence with threats like Mishra's Factory and Faerie Conclave while maintaining control over the game with counter magic and bounce spells.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up your graveyard with cards that have Madness and Threshold abilities in order to take advantage of their powerful effects. By using cards like Wild Mongrel, Basking Rootwalla, and Arrogant Wurm, you can aggressively attack your opponent while also setting up your graveyard for cards like Wonder and Genesis. With the help of Survival of the Fittest, Intuition, and Careful Study, you can manipulate your graveyard and have access to a variety of powerful creatures and spells to overwhelm your opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage while utilizing cards like Standstill and Fact or Fiction to maintain a strong board presence. The inclusion of cycling lands and Mox Diamond allows for efficient mana ramp and card draw, while Lightning Rift provides additional direct damage to quickly close out the game. The deck also includes creature threats like Grim Lavamancer and Mishra's Factory to apply pressure and Faerie Conclave as a versatile land that can turn into a flying threat.

This deck focuses on utilizing counterspells, removal, and card advantage to control the game and prevent the opponent from developing their board. It includes a mix of counterspells like Mana Leak and Counterspell, removal options like Swords to Plowshares and Wrath of God, as well as card advantage tools like Fact or Fiction and Impulse. The deck also includes win conditions like Decree of Justice and Mishra's Factory. The key strategy is to maintain control of the game while slowly gaining incremental advantages until securing victory.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by using various counter spells and removal cards to prevent the opponent from developing their board. The deck also utilizes the Landstill strategy, which involves using cards like Parallax Tide and Fact or Fiction to maintain card advantage while stalling the game. The inclusion of cards like Humility and Decree of Justice can also help to break stalemates and secure victory. Ultimately, this deck aims to outlast the opponent and win through attrition and card advantage.
